hero.title: AX/E 22
hero.heading: AX/E 22 – Axopar's 22ft Electric Powerboat
hero.intro: Unrivaled Elegance, Powered by Innovation: The AX/E 22 isn’t just a boat; it’s a statement. With its silent, efficient electric propulsion and elevated Mediterrana design, every journey becomes an adventure in performance and luxury. Hand-selected materials and expert craftsmanship create an environment where performance and style converge, making every moment on the water as refined as it is exhilarating. Trailerable and versatile, it’s your gateway to electric boating adventures.

sections.title: Power, Precision and Responsiveness
sections.intro:
The AX/E 22 is engineered to thrill. With the Evoy Breeze motor delivering over 120+ HP, this boat surges to a top speed of 36 knots, ensuring every adventure is powered by instant torque and exhilarating acceleration. Its twin-stepped V-hull design enhances agility, making the AX/E 22 a joy to maneuver, whether you're cutting through waves or cruising along the coast. Quiet, powerful, and responsive—this is performance redefined. Leaving nothing but ripples on the water.

Axopar 22 model range awards: The AX/E 22 is not just an electric upgrade—it's the next evolution of the award-winning Axopar 22, originally designed with future electric propulsion in mind. By refining its celebrated platform and adapting it for advanced electric power, the AX/E 22 delivers a seamless blend of innovation, performance, and sustainability for modern boaters.

sections.title: Exhilarating Speeds
sections.intro: The Evoy Breeze motor delivers 120+ HP, propelling the AX/E 22 to a top speed of 36 knots, offering thrilling acceleration and dynamic power on the water.

sections.title: Exceptional Handling
sections.intro: The twin-stepped V-hull design and its lightweight construction ensure outstanding stability and control, enabling precise, confident maneuvers in various sea conditions.

sections.title: Agile Maneuverability
sections.intro: Designed for tight turns and quick responses, the AX/E 22 offers effortless handling, making navigation in both open waters and confined spaces smooth and intuitive.

sections.title: Smooth Ride
sections.intro: With its advanced hull design, the AX/E 22 provides a comfortable, stable ride, minimizing impact and delivering a seamless experience at both low and high speeds.

sections.title: Precision Control
sections.intro: The instant torque of the electric motor ensures immediate response, allowing the driver to feel connected and in full command of the boat’s movements.

sections.title: Eco-Friendly Thrills
sections.intro: Enjoy the thrill of high-speed boating with the added benefit of near-silent operation, creating a serene and immersive connection with the water.

sections.title: Looking into the Future of Electric Boating
Crafted for Your Adventure
sections.intro: The AX/E 22 is more than just a boat—it’s a canvas for your adventures and lifestyle. Available in both Spyder and T-Top designs, this model adapts seamlessly to your needs. Its modular interior offers the flexibility to choose between a multi-storage compartment or a U-Sofa layout, allowing you to tailor the space for ultimate comfort or practicality. The Mediterrana Edition enhances this versatility with luxurious touches like solid wood finishes and premium upholstery, blending warmth and elegance. By using up to 50% less material and integrating recycled marine plastics, the AX/E 22 combines sophisticated design with a commitment to sustainability.

items.name: Interior Finish
items.title: Interior Finish
items.text: The Mediterranean-inspired design incorporates high-end materials, delivering an elegant and refined aesthetic that enhances the onboard experience.

items.name: Luxurious Touches
items.title: Luxurious Touches
items.text: The AX/E Mediterrana upholstery enhances onboard comfort with premium materials, blending style, durability, and a sophisticated look.

items.name: Optimized Helm Station
items.title: Optimized Helm Station
items.text: The ergonomic helm station is designed for ease of use, with an adjustable windshield and intuitive controls, ensuring a protected, controlled boating experience.

items.caption: The Spyder configuration on the AX/E 22 delivers an exhilarating open-air experience, combining sleek design with dynamic handling for those who crave adventure.
The T-Top offers shade and weather protection while maintaining a sleek profile, enhancing both comfort and the sporty aesthetic of the AX/E 22.

items.title: U-Sofa Layout
items.text: The U-Sofa offers a spacious and adaptable seating area, perfect for social gatherings or transforming into a sunbed for ultimate relaxation.

items.title: Multi Storage Compartment
items.text: The Multi Storage Compartment maximizes efficiency, providing storage for gear and essentials while maintaining a clean, organized deck layout.

sections.title: Innovation at Your Fingertips
sections.intro: The AX/E 22's cutting-edge technology keeps you connected and in control. With the intuitive Smart Boating Screen and the E-Brain™ Management System, real-time insights and seamless updates are always within reach. The Evoy App extends this control, offering remote access and management from anywhere, ensuring your boat is always ready for the next adventure.

items.title: Smart Boating Screen
items.text: A comprehensive display system offering real-time navigation, weather updates, Bluetooth, WiFi & 4G connectivity, and more. Stay informed with instant updates on motor and battery status, ensuring a seamless boating experience.

items.title: AX/E App
items.text: Provides remote management capabilities, allowing users to monitor GPS tracking, manage charging, log trips, and share boat access—all from the convenience of a smartphone.

items.title: Smart Monitoring
items.text: Access real-time data on performance, range, and battery health directly from the helm or remotely via the Evoy app, ensuring optimal operation at all times.

items.title: Remote Control
items.text: The AX/E app offers full remote control over essential boat functions, keeping you connected and in command, even when you’re not on board.

items.title: Continuous Updates
items.text: Over-the-air updates ensure that your AX/E 22 is always running the latest software, keeping the boat optimized and ready for future adventures.

sections.title: Explore Further, Charge Faster
sections.intro: The AX/E 22 is designed to deliver more time on the water with minimal interruptions. Equipped with a 63 kWh battery, it offers a powerful range and efficient charging capabilities, ensuring you’re always ready for your next adventure. Whether cruising at high speeds or enjoying a leisurely day out, the AX/E 22 is built for modern electric boating, blending performance, safety, and convenience seamlessly.

items.title: Battery and Range
items.text:
The AX/E 22’s single 63 kWh Kreisel battery offers impressive flexibility. At 5 knots, the boat can travel up to 60 nautical miles or operate for up to 10 hours. When cruising at 25 knots, the range adjusts to approximately 17 nautical miles. This adaptable range makes the AX/E 22 ideal for both slow, scenic exploration and faster-paced adventures.

Kreisel’s advanced battery technology, including patented immersion cooling, guarantees optimal safety, efficiency, and durability, allowing boaters to explore with confidence and ease.

items.title: Rapid Charging for Day Adventures
items.text: When time is of the essence, the AX/E 22’s DC fast charging minimizes downtime. With a 120 kW or 150 kW charger, the boat reaches 80% charge in 50-60 minutes (Plug: 400VAC Trafo). For a full charge, it takes just 1 hour 20 minutes at 120 kW or 1 hour 10 minutes at 150 kW, ensuring you’re quickly back on the water. This rapid charging solution is perfect for keeping day-long adventures uninterrupted.

items.title: Flexible AC Charging Options
items.text: The AX/E 22 offers versatile charging solutions for various power sources. A 40 kW AC charger with a 3-phase 63A, 400VAC connection fully charges the boat in about 1 hour 24 minutes, while a standard 6 kW AC charger with a 1-phase 32A, 230VAC connection takes around 9 hours 25 minutes. This flexibility ensures that whether you’re at a marina or charging at home, the AX/E 22 adapts to various charging infrastructures, so you're always ready for your next adventure.

items.title: Seamless and Convenient
items.text: Recharging the AX/E 22 is designed to fit seamlessly into your day. Whether connected to a standard 230V outlet at the marina or a high-speed DC charger, the boat powers up quickly while you enjoy scenic marina views. This ensures that you spend more time exploring and less time waiting, keeping your adventures on track.
